title: Every Token Counts: Exact Likert-Scale Distributions for Measuring LLM Attitudes and Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Consumer Ethnocentrism Tendencies Scale (CETSCALE) to language models and analyzing exact token-level Probability Mass Functions (PMFs) using a fully crossed factorial design and distributional ANOVA to isolate systemic biases and interactions between the model's country of origin and various target countries (e.g., USA, China, Canada, France).
